title: A voicemail from your own number — Part 2
style: Warm painterly 2D cartoon illustration, cinematic graphic-novel look: clean bold dark outlines, rich textured digital painting, soft volumetric light, deep warm oranges and moody blues, detailed environment, vertical 9:16 composition.
character: MAIN CHARACTER: a lanky ADULT man drawn as a minimalist cartoon: a perfectly round smooth tan head, two tiny solid black dot eyes set wide apart, short thin eyebrow strokes, a very small simple mouth, no nose, no visible hair, simple long limbs, dark charcoal baseball cap, oversized heather-grey hoodie, black slim pants, white sneakers. Minimal face like a webcomic, not a child, not anime, no big eyes.

scenes.A: Night, the man declining a call on his phone in his dark bedroom, then holding the phone to his ear speaking urgently, streetlight glow.
scenes.B: Morning, the man standing on his apartment street watching fire trucks and caution tape around a tall office building in the distance, people evacuated on the sidewalk.
scenes.C: The man sitting on a couch next to his younger brother who is laughing nervously and holding up a phone showing an audio app with a waveform, no readable text.
scenes.D: Close-up portrait of the man facing the viewer, raised eyebrow, half smiling, half suspicious, living room behind him.

segments.text: You decline. And you call the police.
By the time they arrive, the streetlight is empty.
You stay home from work anyway.
At nine a.m., your office building is evacuated. A gas leak on your floor.
Nobody is hurt. But you can't stop shaking.
That night, your little brother finally confesses. He made the voicemail with an AI voice app. As a prank.

ui.label: THE CALLER
ui.value: AN AI COPY OF YOUR VOICE

segments.text: The gas leak? Pure coincidence. That's what he says, anyway. The end.
